rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>Please attack the transport ships
trying to leave the area.<ab(1500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>We'll also have the Flail unit hold them up.<ab(800)><ed()>
rows.notes: Flail is the existing provisional rendering of Freil from proposals_dialogue_00696.json; not re-proposed.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>It's a Vulture raid!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Don't hand over that cargo.<ab(500)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>I want to protect Rutil.
But can I really do it, as I am now...?<ab(800)><ed()>
rows.notes: Speaker is Jamil by context (4207-4214 exchange); no name inserted into the line itself.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>Jamil... Believe in your own strength.<ab(200)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>I'm sure you can do it.<ab(800)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>Today, you're the star.
Play the part through to the end.<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>...I suppose so.<ab(800)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>I cannot hand Rutil over.
Whatever it takes, I will win this fight.<ab(500)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>I'm the one at the controls.
So sit back and trust me completely.<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: 'Ride on a big ship' idiom rendered as trusting completely; no literal ship invented.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>Garrod, please look after Jamil...<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Confirmed: the target has stopped!<ab(500)>
rows.notes: Source row has no <ed()>; kept as-is.

rows.target:
<sp(20)>There are still targets remaining.
Please continue the operation.<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Source row has no <op()>, continuing the previous box; kept as-is.

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>If you free the Flail unit from combat,
they'll move to hold the transports.<ab(1000)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>The target is trying to escape!<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>An enemy transport has entered the operation area.<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>More enemy transports have appeared.<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Enemy transports incoming!<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>The enemy force has begun advancing!<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Enemy reinforcements!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Keep it up!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Break through in one go!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Is this the last one...!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>The target has left the operation area!<ab(1000)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Damn it... So it failed?!<ab(1000)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>Damage to the Nadesico is worsening.
Please provide support.<ab(1000)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>The Nadesico is in serious danger.
Please provide support.<ab(1200)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>M-main engine, critically damaged!!
Captain!!<ab(1000)><ed()>
rows.notes: Stammer kept on first English word as in prior batches.

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>This ship is being abandoned.
All hands, evacuate.<ab(1500)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>Very little operation time remains...
Please hurry!<ab(1000)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Captain, any more of this and...!<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Has the operation... failed...?<ab(1000)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Allied forces are under attack!<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>One allied unit has been wiped out!<ab(800)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>We will retrieve the L System no matter what.
Everyone, I'm counting on you.<ab(1000)><ed()>
rows.notes: L System spelled without a hyphen per encyclopedia_021_a.json's reconciliation note (wiki form wins over character_names_021's hyphenated 'L-System'); see uncertainties.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>It's reassuring having Jamil out there.<ab(300)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>You said it.
What a difference from some kid out there.<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.notes: Referent of 'a certain kid' left unidentified; no name supplied. See uncertainties.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>How could I stay silent after hearing that?!<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.notes: 'quiet' replaced with 'silent' to avoid the font's unsupported lowercase q (per project rule; not a locked name).

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>Guess we have to be the ones to save them.<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Object of 'save' left as source leaves it (unspecified 'them'); not supplied from invention.

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>Jamil...
You've got yourself some good comrades.<ab(800)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>Everyone's fighting while carrying some pain of their own.
And yet, I...<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Speaker confirmed as Gainer by the following row's direct address; still no name inserted into this line.

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>Don't push yourself too hard, Gainer.
Having a reason to fight that's your own is enough.<ab(800)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>You're right.
Then for now... it's for Rutil's sake!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: -san honorific on Rutil dropped per corpus convention.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>Jamil, are you all right?<ab(300)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Yeah... Sorry to worry you.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>We'll back you up.<ab(500)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>The young ones are doing their best too.
There's no need to rush.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Everyone... I'm grateful to you.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>So the GX can fight like that...!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>So Jamil really was amazing, huh.<ab(500)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>Even with his Newtype ability gone,
he's still a top-flight pilot.<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: He/his used for Jamil, whose gender is already locked in character_names_021.json; not inferred from name alone.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>We will take the L System.<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Speaker is one of the Frost brothers by context; no name inserted.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>It's only in our hands that it has any real meaning.<ab(300)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>A New Federation Gundam... Those brothers?!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: New Federation per terms_028.json orchestrator ruling (glossary.json wins over character_names_021's 'New UNE'); matches book(38) usage already locked in batches 1346-2055.

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>Once we get serious,
you won't even be worth counting.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>We can show our true strength by fighting as a pair.<ab(200)>
rows.notes: Source row has no <ed()>; kept as-is.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>We underestimated you before, but today we're serious.<ab(200)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>You'd best say your prayers now.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Today's GX seems to have something extra to it.<ab(300)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>Jamil Neate...
So the tragic hero makes his entrance.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>I sense strong hatred from them.<ab(300)>
rows.notes: Source row has no <ed()>; kept as-is.

rows.target: <sp(20)>Deep hatred, with no bottom in sight...<ab(300)>
rows.notes: Source row has no <op()> or <ed()>, continuing the previous box; kept as-is.

rows.target: <sp(20)>What is it that's driving them...?<ab(800)><ed()>
rows.notes: Speaker of 4265-4267 (likely Tiffa, sensing the Frost brothers) not named; no identity asserted beyond source.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>The likes of you could never understand.<ab(300)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Because you're going to perish right here.<ab(300)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>I won't let the likes of you interfere with Jamil's...
with Rutil's feelings!<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Fools who don't even understand the L System's worth.<ab(300)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>Shut up!
I will not forgive you!<ab(800)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>These two together are a real handful!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Small fry stay small fry, however many gather.<ab(200)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Don't talk big!<ab(200)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>I'll show you exactly what small fry can do!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>These guys... They're tough!<ab(200)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>So you're Gainer Sanga, the Game Champ.
It's an honor to fight you.<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Game Champ per terms_028.json locked term.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>But this won't go like a game!<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Jamil, let's use the G-Bit.<ab(300)>
rows.notes: G-Bit per mission_terms_019.json / encyclopedia_022.json locked spelling. Source row has no <ed()>; kept as-is.

rows.target:
<sp(20)>Right now, the only thing that can break this situation open
is the Flash System.<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Flash System per encyclopedia_022.json locked spelling. Source row has no <op()>, continuing the previous box; kept as-is.

uncertainties.note: Standard bridge/HUD alert style continued from earlier missions; no speaker identity asserted for the operator voice.
'a certain kid' (dokka no bouya) left unidentified; likely mocks a younger pilot (possibly Garrod) but nothing in the adjacent rows confirms it, so no name was supplied.

Two glossary sources disagree on hyphenation: character_names_021.json's Rutil entry says 'L-System' while encyclopedia_021_a.json explicitly notes the Gundam wiki writes 'L System' (no hyphen) and treats that as the resolving form. Used 'L System' (no hyphen) throughout this batch; flagging for centralized confirmation since this is the corpus's first dialogue use of the term.

Speaker is one of the Frost brothers (Shagia/Olba) by scene context (they are named a few rows later at 4300-4301 in the next slice); the brothers are not distinguished from each other in this stretch, so no specific name was assigned to either line.
Speaker sensing 'strong hatred' from the Frost brothers is not named in this row range; likely a Newtype character (Tiffa) but left unattributed.

validation.controls: All angle-bracket commands preserved in source order for every row, including rows with no leading <op()> (continuation boxes) and rows with no trailing <ed()>/<ab()> variance.
validation.fit: Full meaning retained; no row shortened for display width. All visible strings checked <= 110 characters.
validation.format: No literal newlines; \n used only where the source itself has \n. ASCII only; no bare %, no lowercase j/q outside locked names (Jamil, Gainer, Rutil-adjacent forms not applicable) where a synonym existed.
validation.meaning_review: Independently meaning-reviewed against the Japanese source (review_04202.json): all 80 rows checked, no mistranslations or reversed meaning found; one wording fix applied (dialogue_04242, 'quiet' to 'silent' to remove an unsupported lowercase q, not a meaning change) and all rows set to meaning_reviewed.
